propositions: Serena symbol tool schemas are deferred by default, requiring an extra ToolSearch round-trip before first use, adding friction compared to non-deferred tools like Bash/grep
ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH is the only available lever to control deferral; it is all-or-nothing globally scoped with no per-tool or per-server granularity
Loading all Serena tool schemas to make symbol tools resident costs approximately 25k minimum input tokens (measured floor) to 64k with a full MCP server surface
A tracked .claude/settings.json with ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH set to false will make symbol tools resident without discovery friction, accepting the context cost tradeoff
.claude/ directory is gitignored; tracking only settings.json requires a negation in .gitignore to prevent the entire directory from being ignored
